# Pintask

> Pintask is a personal task tracker with the most customizable free Kanban board on the web. Pin, prioritize, and manage your work — extend it with real JavaScript when you outgrow the defaults.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Pintask, the personal task tracker.
- [Features](/features): Full feature list — Kanban boards, nested cards, time tracking, integrations.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free forever, Co-Founder Lifetime ($39), and Loyalty Club ($8/mo grandfathered).
- [Extensions](/extensions): Optional paid extensions (mirroring, time tracking, AI briefing).
- [Trello Alternative](/trello-alternative): How Pintask compares to Trello.
- [Kanban Board](/kanban-board): Guide to using Pintask as a Kanban board.
- [Task Tracker](/task-tracker): Guide to using Pintask as a personal task tracker.
- [About](/about): The story and beliefs behind Pintask.
- [Blog](/blog): Productivity, Kanban, and task management articles.
